label: Property entailment as modal universal…: A8P1 describes a property as a term, concept or abstract…
term: property entailment as modal universal inclusion in A8 and ordinary A9
definition: A8P1 describes a property as a term, concept or abstract entity characterizing whatever has it. Its entails title says necessarily anything characterized by X is characterized by Y. A8C uses that modal universal inclusion and A8C2 explicitly allows necessarily false antecedents to entail vacuously. This is not relevant, causal, explanatory or independently nontrivial consequence. A9P1’s ordinary-entails title is byte-identical to A8P1’s; A9 contrasts that SAME ordinary sense with a distinct nontrivial criterion.
note: No complete formal property domain, actualist/possibilist quantification or selected correspondence with Kripke Property/Box fields is established. A9’s nontrivial-entailment distinction is not silently substituted. Existing Scott positivity uses a separate classifier and global closure/exclusion axioms; no equivalence or complement-exclusion bridge is supplied. This extends source provenance to A9’s ordinary contrast only, without broadening the existing ordinary relation or equating it with NT.
